title: Nationaleinkommen aus Kreislaufdaten berechnen
scene: Topic: Calculate the national-income measure defined by given circular-flow income components. Scene: a resident household at the centre receiving two clearly distinguished gold income streams, one earned through work and the other through business/property income. A small domestic-workplace motif and an outside-world/globe motif feed these streams toward the resident household; foreign income of residents is included. Use large neutral labels "Inländer", "Arbeit", "Vermögen" and a central basket "Primäreinkommen". Off to one side show two separate subdued financing/redistribution cards labelled "Transfers" and "Kredite", visually kept outside the primary-income basket, without depicting them as worthless or as negative payments. No numerical example, no GDP identity, no double counting, no implication that income depends solely on the place it arises. Keep the household and the earned-income collection dominant, the outside cards secondary and uncluttered.

title: Volkswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen fachlich einordnen
scene: Topic: classify a supplied economy-wide question by the economic relationship studied. A thoughtful young adult examines two large neutral question bubbles. One combines a broad basket of ordinary goods with rising price tags and an unchanged income pouch, leading to a clearly labelled topic area "Preise". The other combines factory orders, production and workers, leading to a topic area "Konjunktur". The person points to the relationships, not just to isolated money icons. Two large spacious lanes, no numerical data, no guaranteed empirical chain, no policy judgement. Big heading "Welche Beziehung?". Any cards are floating diagram elements, not papers held backwards. Make the broad economic-topic grouping visually distinct from a micro/macro magnifying-glass lesson.

title: Eigene wirtschaftliche Modellannahmen begründen
scene: Topic: author and justify a purpose-appropriate economic model assumption, then check its limitations against material. Show a real fictional kiosk with several different daily stacks of reusable cups on the left, a simplified cup-and-cost model in a large neutral inset at centre, and a magnifying glass linking the simplified model back to the varied cups on the right. A young analyst actively assembles the simplified model, not merely selects a ready answer. Large labels "Fall", "Annahme?", "Prüfen". A small target icon near the model signifies the stated explanatory purpose. Show simplification and checking, not a guaranteed forecast or a universal correct assumption. No numbers, formulas, tiny axes or physical worksheets.

title: Wirtschaftliche Informationen gezielt recherchieren
scene: Topic: independently research economic information with traceable source and relevance. One young adult searches on a laptop viewed over their shoulder, with the screen correctly facing the user. The screen contains only large abstract search and chart symbols, no tiny readable UI. A large neutral question symbol connects to two accessible source motifs, a public-statistics building/page and an open reference book, then to a short trace represented by a chain-link, calendar and bookmark. Big labels "Frage", "Quelle", "Fundstelle". The source origin and locator are visible ideas; there is no fabricated URL, result figure or personal/company record. Do not show a ready-made AI answer being accepted as research. Keep one person, two sources, one simple trace, spacious and legible.

title: Eine wirtschaftliche Untersuchungsfrage präzisieren
scene: Topic: formulate an answerable bounded economic research question from supplied material. A school kiosk has a disposable cup and a reusable cup with large coin/cost symbols. Nearby a large simple calendar represents a limited period. A thoughtful student links these supplied facts into a new large question bubble, shown as their active formulation. Neutral large labels "Gegenstand", "Vergleich", "Zeitraum" accompany the three concrete motifs, leading to a central question mark. No ready task sentence, no numerical result, no claim about environmental superiority, no extra unknown information treated as known. No physical worksheet held toward the viewer. Differentiate this from hypothesis-testing: the image is about delimiting what a question asks.

title: Eine prüfbare wirtschaftliche Hypothese formulieren
scene: Topic: formulate a testable economic hypothesis and name possible supporting or contradicting observations. A large friendly bus and a fare tag with a downward arrow establish the fictional question. At centre a neutral bubble labelled "Vermutung?" leads to two clearly hypothetical alternatives for counted paid journeys: one panel labelled "mehr" with more ticket symbols, one labelled "nicht mehr" with the same or fewer ticket symbols. Above both alternatives use one big heading "Prüfen". A thoughtful observer with a simple tally counter considers both alternatives; do not give the observer a backwards-facing notepad. No actual measured data or guaranteed causal conclusion, no checkmark declaring the hypothesis proven, no percentage formula. Keep the large bus/fare, question and two outcome alternatives clear at360px.

title: Eigene wirtschaftliche Ergebnisse zur Kritik stellen
scene: Topic: expose one’s own economic finding and assumptions to substantive critique. Two friendly older students examine a shared large neutral display comparing disposable and reusable cup costs. The author points to their own result under the large heading "Ergebnis"; the peer raises a concrete question bubble containing a smaller cup-volume motif and "Annahme?". A curved revision arrow leads back to the comparison, showing a reasoned reconsideration rather than automatic agreement. No numbers or claimed universal winner, no grades or thumbs-up mastery badge. If the display is physical, both people face it correctly; preferably use a neutral shared inset without actor-held paper. Make the economic cups/costs and the focused questioning obvious, with a welcoming constructive expression.

title: Wirtschaftliche Positionen dialogisch vertreten
scene: Topic: engage responsively in an economic dialogue. Two adults at a simple meeting table face one another, listening and speaking in turn. One large speech bubble proposes a delivery option, with a parcel and a calendar; the counterpart's large question bubble contains a coin pouch to raise the budget concern. A third short returning bubble links the same parcel, timing and budget icons as a conditional response. Neutral big labels "Vorschlag", "Rückfrage", "Antwort" placed above the respective bubbles. No fully written speech, no guaranteed delivery probability, no person monologuing at an audience, no reversed documents. The interaction is respectful, substantive and reciprocal; keep the three bubbles few and large.

title: Kaufmannseigenschaft normgestützt prüfen
scene: Topic: assess legal merchant status from the nature and scale of a business using a supplied rule. A friendly analyst examines a large neutral law book labelled "HGB" beside two business-case motifs: a organised distribution operation with warehouse crates, a small team and accounting, and a small uncomplicated repair workshop with a wrench and one operator. A big neutral question inset labelled "Art + Umfang" connects the concrete organisation needs to the supplied rule. No simple employee-count threshold, no absolute "small businesses never merchants" verdict, no occupational-salesperson badge. Do not display tick/cross conclusions for unprovided case facts. The law book should be on a stand correctly oriented toward the analyst, or a neutral inset with no directional print. Large clear warm comic objects, no fine print.

title: Firma als Handelsnamen eines Kaufmanns einordnen
scene: Topic: distinguish a merchant's commercial trading NAME from the acting person and the business operation. One friendly workshop proprietor beside a clear simple workshop building. A large shop-sign element and a neutral invoice-heading inset show the same fictional name "Lichtblick e.K."; these signify the name used in business dealings, not a second person or additional legal entity. Large neutral labels "Person" near the proprietor, "Betrieb" near the workshop and the main heading "Firma = Name" near the sign. No readable signature or full invoice fine print, no trademark-validity judgement. The proprietor is not holding a backwards-facing document. Emphasise one actor, one operation, and a name used in dealings, with generous whitespace.

title: Eine Handelsregistereintragung normgestützt deuten
scene: Topic: interpret a specific commercial-register fact using the conditions of a supplied legal rule. One large public register book or board labelled "Register" occupies the centre. Three large clear neutral condition motifs are connected: an entry stamp labelled "Eintrag", a public notice/broadcast motif labelled "Bekannt", and a clock labelled "Zeit". Two business participants look toward the public record and the relevant notice, rather than signing a whole contract. Include a prominent question mark linking the conditions to the particular legal consequence, without a universal validity checkmark. No statement that every registered fact makes all contracts valid, no law paragraph fine print, no invented person/company record. Show public documentation and conditional interpretation, not a notary or court verdict. Books/boards must face their actual readers correctly.

title: Kaufmännische Vertretungsmacht im Fall prüfen
scene: Topic: check the scope of an expressly granted commercial authority for a specified act. A proprietor gives an employee a large neutral authority/key symbol labelled "Vollmacht". The employee considers a clear ordinary spare-parts order, represented by labelled "Einkauf" boxes and gears, alongside a distinct borrowing option, represented by a bank/coin motif labelled "Darlehen?" and a separate keyhole/question symbol. A neutral law-book inset labelled "HGB" connects both acts to the scope check. The ordinary order belongs to the described task; borrowing raises the question of additional power, not merely amount. No image of unlimited authority, no conflation with procuration, no claim that every loan is always forbidden. No tiny contract text or misleading physical paperwork; keep the proprietor, representative and two acts readable.

title: Gesellschaftstheorien wirtschaftlich charakterisieren
scene: Topic: compare explicitly simplified social-theory models by property, economic coordination and interests, without endorsing one. Two equally sized calm warm comic panels show the SAME simple factory/machine and similar ordinary people. On the left private control is represented by one owner symbol and decentralised price/contract arrows between actors; on the right social ownership is represented by a group-of-people symbol and a central planning node with outward instructions. Large neutral headings "Modell L" and "Modell M", and brief bottom labels "dezentral" and "zentral". One comparison link connects the panels. Equal friendly visual treatment, no propaganda stars, portraits, misery/success ranking, flags, efficiency scores or claim about every historical system. The abstract planning note is a floating inset, not a backwards-facing clipboard held by a person. Large simple objects and no fine print.

title: Finanzielle Unternehmenskrisen anhand von Material erkennen
scene: Topic: recognise business financial distress from available funds versus payments due and identify affected actors, without a legal insolvency diagnosis. A small friendly business at centre with a concerned but calm owner. Two big neutral number cards show the fictional example: due wages/supplier bills "12.000 €" beside a clock, available money "8.000 €" beside an open coin pouch. The smaller available amount is clearly distinct from what is due; do not count hoped-for orders as current cash. A modest gap symbol links these cards to two large actor motifs: an employee and a supplier with a delivery box, both shown affected, not blamed. No bankruptcy stamp, court, legal classification or catastrophic closed-shop scene. The values correspond to one fictional cash shortfall, not inventory value or profits. No fine print, backwards-held bills or extra numbers.
